claims.title: Rank-one recurrence, mass-degree drift and a recurrent higher-molecularity marked-method obstruction

quoted_fields.interface: Finite stochastic mass-action reaction graph with arbitrary finite species count, complexes in N_0^d, every constant rate kappa_r>0 and weak reversibility. Generator Lf(x)=sum_r kappa_r*(x)_(y_r)*(f(x+y'_r-y_r)-f(x)), with falling-factorial propensities and disabled sources. The full target quantifies over every initial population and every nonabsorbing reachable class: nonexplosion, positive recurrence, unique stationary probability and TV convergence. Absorbing singletons carry point mass. The full theorem assumes no complex balance, added outflows, given Lyapunov certificate, bounded class or stationary oracle. Rank-one, mass-degree and cone results retain their extra stated conditions.
quoted_fields.failure: Closed mutual reachability does not imply finite mean returns or nonexplosion. Rank-one ordering does not control competing directions in rank>=2. The negative mass drift holds only in the specified cone; the restoring source can be disabled at boundary faces. D>=3 gives no global linear Lyapunov upper bound from this calculation. The degree-five example is explicitly positive recurrent and refutes only a direct terminal-rarity/fixed-residual proof extension; accepted binary one-linkage and earlier terminal-gap results remain at their original scopes. Supplied/producer literature descriptions, unresolved chat citation handles and an announced two-species result are not new Capital governing-original reads or an unrestricted theorem import. No held paper/GitHub tree, mirror, original ZIP or extra attachment was recovered. GPT-6 standard/Extra High was selected at dispatch; exact model throughout, helper models and compute remain unconfirmed. This completed Xi return is separate from human-interrupted earlier material and establishes no model-comparison winner.
